symptoms: fresh blood in vomitus and faeces
bleeding from the nose, gums and vagina
diagnosis: reverse transcriptase polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR) assay
virus isolation by cell culture in maximum containment laboratories
transmission: prolonged exposure to mines or caves inhabited by Rousettus fruit bat colonies
burial ceremonies that involve direct contact with the body of the deceased
risk_factors: prolonged exposure to mines or caves inhabited by Rousettus fruit bat colonies
close contact with patients with MVD
complications: involvement of the central nervous system
key_facts: average MVD case fatality rate is around 50%
case fatality rates have varied from 24% to 88% in past outbreaks
